The verdicts for 'Elevated rectangular platform' and 'Front edge (proscenium)' being absent are accurate; there is no vertical drop or architectural separation. The Router was also correct to flag the flooring material as non-conforming (red carpet vs. matte black/wood). I agree with all Router verdicts. The only passing checkpoint ('Side and rear may have wings') is technically true due to the curtains, but this single feature does not salvage the alignment given the failure of primary structural definitions.
artifact_review: The Router identified three distinct artifacts: structural collapse in the white podium, texture anomalies on the model, and blur in the foreground audience. I agree with these findings. Additionally, visual inspection reveals that the red geometric props flanking the path lack clear grounding shadows and appear to float slightly or merge with the floor texture, suggesting a 'floating object' artifact not explicitly detailed by the Router. The seated figure behind the podium also exhibits anatomical ambiguity (limbs blending into the desk), reinforcing the structural collapse severity. The foreground blur is consistent with AI crowd generation rather than optical bokeh. The severity ratings (3, 2, 1) are appropriate.
